Hi Sara —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the integration. We're ready to start vendor onboarding so Procurement can create your supplier record and issue the initial PO. To get you into our Coupa supplier portal we need you to complete the vendor registration link below and upload the W-9 and bank info where indicated:

https://coupa.com/supplier/register/REDWOOD-portal

Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (brief checklist, required docs)

If you run into any account creation trouble please paste screenshots into a reply and we'll escalate to Coupa support. Typical required items: W-9, business address, DUNS or Tax ID, contact for invoices, and bank account details for ACH. After Procurement confirms the record we'll issue the PO and share the purchase order number and AP contact.

Target timeline: if we have completed forms by end of day Friday (02/27) we can issue an initial PO by Monday.

Next steps for you:
- Try the registration link above and upload W-9 (or let us know if you prefer to email the W-9 to secure-upload@redwood.com)
- Send any screenshots if you encounter an error

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

Best,

Looping in Procurement ops —

Marissa: thanks for the heads up. Typical process here is:
1) Vendor completes supplier registration in Coupa (we need Supplier ID).
2) Procurement validates W-9 and bank info, runs quick vendor screening.
3) We create the supplier record and add payment terms, then AP issues initial PO.

Given Sara's sign-up token error, please open a support ticket with Coupa (I've submitted one already). Ticket: https://support.coupa.com/ticket/C-123456

Lauren — any legal concerns with us receiving W-9 and banking info via secure-upload@redwood.com versus DocuSign? If we can get W-9 today we can be fast.

I've attached the standard Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf to this thread (copy of what I sent to the vendor). Also note: if Atlas prefers we can manually create the supplier record and send a private link for secure document upload — that avoids portal self-registration issues but adds ~1 business day.

Next steps:
- Marissa: offer the DocuSign onboarding packet link if vendor prefers not to self-register
- Sara: if you can email back W-9 and bank ACH stub (or upload), we'll proceed with manual create.

-Vivek

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the screenshot — looks like a verification token expiry case. Two options to unblock quickly:

1) Alternate: use this one-time registration link (expires in 72h): https://coupa.com/supplier/register/REDWOOD-portal?otp=Z7a2
2) Or, if you'd prefer not to use the portal, complete the DocuSign onboarding packet here and we'll create your supplier record manually: https://docusign.net/sign/XYZ-ONBOARD-ATLAS

Either way, we'll need the W-9 (attached one you sent will be fine) and bank info for ACH. You can upload to the portal, attach to DocuSign, or send to secure-upload@redwood.com — whichever is easiest. We will treat that channel as secure for onboarding materials.

Once we have W-9 + bank stub and confirm your supplier details, Procurement will create the vendor record and issue the PO. Expect supplier creation + PO in ~3 business days after receipt of docs if no further questions.

I'll also escalate to Coupa support on my side if the one-time link doesn't work.

Thanks —
